snippet.title: Medieval Frontiers Closed Beta Trailer
snippet.description:
CLOSED BETA IS OPEN. We need Builders & Breakers.
This is a raw dev build of Medieval Frontiers: unpolished, real, and (yes) buggy.

Your mission:
- Push the logistics system to the edge.
- Build everything you can. Try to break the economy.
- Hunt major bugs and tell us what feels off.

What you get:
- Access to the raw dev build (Unpolished. Real. Buggy.)
- A direct line to the dev team in the #beta-feedback channel
- Impact: Your feedback shapes balancing and what we focus on next

We accept a limited number of testers to keep feedback manageable.

WARNING:
If you want a finished game, please wait for Early Access.
If you want to help shape the foundation, now is the time.

Join here 👉 https://discord.gg/5tZj9gnx9t

Visit us:
https://activefungus-studios.de/
https://www.instagram.com/activefungus/

#MedievalFrontiers #ClosedBeta #IndieGame #ColonySim #SurvivalBuilder
